title: POST /api/integration/client-token (body)
description: The integration delivers the long-lived access token of a device's own HA user. Integration token only. Idempotent: the same refresh_token_id again is acknowledged with unchanged=true and nothing is re-sent to the app; a different refresh_token_id replaces the stored token (rotation) and the hub pushes client_config_updated to the device, waits for its get_client_config (max 5 s) plus 3 s, then answers. The integration removes every other token of that HA user only AFTER the 200. The bearer is stored encrypted, never logged, never returned. Binding: the hub accepts a delivery only (a) while the device waits for its token (ha_token_status pending, listed in provisioning[]), (b) with the request_id of an open rotation of this device, or (c) unsolicited for the HA user already stored for the device (the integration rotates on its own when local_only changes or a guest token no longer covers the expiry). Anything else is answered 422 request_required. Under the Supervisor the integration token itself is accepted only from the hub's own host (Home Assistant Core), never from the LAN or other add-ons.

token.description: HA access token (JWT) of the device's long-lived refresh token.

request_id.description: Echo of provision_client.request_id / provisioning[].request_id, if the delivery answers a request. Required to deliver a token for a different HA user than the stored one outside the pending phase.
